stem_book: Three blocks of masses 1 kg, 2 kg and 3 kg hang one below the other from a ceiling (1 kg on top, 3 kg at the bottom) by light strings: T₃ is the tension in the string from the ceiling to the 1 kg block, T₂ between the 1 kg and 2 kg blocks, T₁ between the 2 kg and 3 kg blocks (see figure). Find T₃ in newton. (g = 10 m/s²)
reason: g = 10 m/s² unstated in print; added.
work: T₃ supports all three blocks: T₃ = (1 + 2 + 3)·10 = 60 N
